BC3501: The long-sleeve half of the Bella+Canvas retail family. Same trim, side-seamed cut as the 3001, so a drop that mixes short and long sleeves still reads as one collection. It earns its place from October on, when a short-sleeve tee has stopped being enough and a hoodie is too much. The smooth combed-cotton face takes screen print and DTG cleanly, and the sleeves open a second canvas — a repeat wordmark down the arm is the detail that makes merch look designed rather than decorated.
